name: openai
title: OpenAI
description: OpenAI endpoint for chat completion, Responses API, embeddings, audio transcription, audio translation, and text-to-speech.
label: ai

properties.name: operation
properties.description: The operation to perform: 'chat-completion', 'responses', 'embeddings', 'tool-execution', 'audio-transcription', 'audio-translation', or 'audio-speech'

properties.name: additionalBodyProperty
properties.description: Additional JSON properties to include in the request body (e.g. additionalBodyProperty.traceId=123). This is a multi-value option with prefix: additionalBodyProperty.

properties.name: additionalHeader
properties.description: Additional HTTP request headers to send with every API call (e.g. additionalHeader.OpenAI-Organization=my-org or additionalHeader.api-key=secret). Values may contain secrets. This is a multi-value option with prefix: additionalHeader.

properties.name: additionalResponseHeader
properties.description: Map additional fields from the response message to Camel headers. The key is the field name in the API response, the value is the Camel header name (e.g. additionalResponseHeader.reasoning_content=CamelMyReasoningHeader). This is a multi-value option with prefix: additionalResponseHeader.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.description: OpenAI API key. Can also be set via OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: audioLanguage
properties.description: The language of the input audio in ISO-639-1 format (e.g., 'en'). Improves accuracy and latency.

properties.name: audioModel
properties.description: The model to use for audio transcription (e.g., whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe)

properties.name: audioPrompt
properties.description: Optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment

properties.name: audioResponseFormat
properties.description: The format of the transcription output

properties.name: audioTemperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature for transcription (0.0 to 1.0)

properties.name: audioTimestampGranularities
properties.description: Comma-separated timestamp granularities: 'word', 'segment', or 'word,segment'. Only applicable with verbose_json response format.

properties.name: autoToolExecution
properties.description: When true and MCP servers are configured, automatically execute tool calls and loop back to the model. When false, tool calls are returned as the message body for manual handling.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Base URL for OpenAI API. Defaults to OpenAI's official endpoint. Can be used for local or third-party providers.

properties.name: builtinTools
properties.description: Comma-separated hosted tools for the Responses API: web_search, file_search, code_interpreter

properties.name: conversationHistoryProperty
properties.description: Exchange property name for storing conversation history

properties.name: conversationMemory
properties.description: Enable conversation memory per Exchange

properties.name: developerMessage
properties.description: Developer message to prepend before user messages

properties.name: dimensions
properties.description: Number of dimensions for the embedding output. Only supported by text-embedding-3 models. Reducing dimensions can lower costs and improve performance without significant quality loss.

properties.name: embeddingModel
properties.description: The model to use for embeddings

properties.name: encodingFormat
properties.description: The format for embedding output: 'float' for list of floats, 'base64' for compressed format

properties.name: fileSearchVectorStoreIds
properties.description: Comma-separated vector store ids required when builtinTools includes file_search

properties.name: hallucinatedToolNameStrategy
properties.description: Strategy for handling tool names hallucinated by the model (tool not found in any MCP server). 'failExchange' (default) throws an IllegalStateException, failing the exchange immediately. 'repromptModel' sends a corrective tool result listing the available tools so the model can self-correct and retry. The maxToolIterations option bounds retries.

properties.name: hostedMcpTools
properties.description: JSON array of hosted MCP tool definitions (OpenAI Tool.Mcp) passed through to the Responses API

properties.name: jsonSchema
properties.description: JSON schema for structured output validation

properties.name: maxAgenticTokens
properties.description: Maximum cumulative prompt plus completion tokens allowed across the MCP agentic loop. When 0 or negative, no token budget is enforced. Enforcement runs after each API call that requests further tool execution, so actual spend may exceed the configured budget by up to one call (typically the largest, as the prompt grows each iteration). A final text response is returned even when cumulative usage exceeds the budget.

properties.name: maxHistoryMessages
properties.description: When conversationMemory is enabled, retain at most this many messages in the exchange conversation history. System and developer messages are prepended separately and are not stored in history. Assistant tool-call blocks are kept intact and may retain slightly more than this limit to preserve tool result pairing. When 0, no message limit is applied.

properties.name: maxHistoryTokens
properties.description: When conversationMemory is enabled, trim conversation history using a token estimate (character count / 4, including image payload size for multi-modal user messages). Oldest segments are dropped first until the estimated tokens are within this limit. Assistant tool-call blocks are removed as a unit with their tool results. The most recent segment is always retained, even when it alone exceeds this limit. When 0, no token limit is applied.

properties.name: maxRetries
properties.description: Maximum number of times the OpenAI SDK client retries failed requests. The SDK retry is rate-limit aware (honors Retry-After on 429).

properties.name: maxTokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

properties.name: maxToolIterations
properties.description: Maximum number of tool call loop iterations to prevent infinite loops

properties.name: mcpProtocolVersions
properties.description: Comma-separated list of MCP protocol versions to advertise when connecting to MCP servers using Streamable HTTP transport. When not set, the SDK default is used. Example: 2024-11-05,2025-03-26,2025-06-18

properties.name: mcpReconnect
properties.description: Automatically reconnect to MCP servers when a tool call fails due to a transport error, and retry the call once.

properties.name: mcpServer
properties.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configurations. Define servers using prefix notation: mcpServer..transportType=stdiossestreamableHttp, (Note that sse is deprecated) mcpServer..command= (stdio), mcpServer..args= (stdio), mcpServer..url= (sse/streamableHttp), mcpServer..oauthProfile= (OAuth profile for HTTP auth, requires camel-oauth), mcpServer..toolNames= (optional include list to restrict which tools are registered from this server). This is a multi-value option with prefix: mcpServer.

properties.name: mcpTimeout
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP tool call requests. Applies to all MCP operations including tool execution and initialization.

properties.name: mcpToolRefresh
properties.description: Refresh the advertised tool list when an MCP server notifies that its tools changed. Set to false to keep the tool list fixed to what was listed when the endpoint started, for deployments that require a deterministic set of tools.

properties.name: model
properties.description: The model to use for chat completion

properties.name: outputClass
properties.description: Fully qualified class name for structured output using response format

properties.name: parallelToolExecution
properties.description: Execute the tool calls returned by the model in a single response concurrently instead of sequentially. Tool calls in the same batch are independent by design, so this reduces the latency of a batch to that of its slowest tool. Results are always fed back to the model in the original tool call order. Note that with toolExecutionErrorStrategy=failExchange the sibling tool calls already dispatched complete before the exchange fails.

properties.name: parallelToolTimeout
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a batch of parallel tool calls, so that one slow tool cannot block the whole batch. The timeout applies to the batch as a whole, not per tool call. A tool call that exceeds it is cancelled and handled according to toolExecutionErrorStrategy. The default of 0 disables the batch timeout and relies on mcpTimeout, which already bounds each individual MCP request. Only used when parallelToolExecution=true.

properties.name: previousResponseId
properties.description: Previous response id for OpenAI server-side conversation state (Responses API only)

properties.name: requestTimeout
properties.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for the OpenAI SDK client. When 0 or negative, the SDK default (10 minutes) is used.

properties.name: speechInstructions
properties.description: Optional instructions to control the voice of the generated audio. Does not work with tts-1 or tts-1-hd.

properties.name: speechModel
properties.description: The model to use for text-to-speech (e.g., gpt-4o-mini-tts, tts-1, tts-1-hd)

properties.name: speechResponseFormat
properties.description: The audio format for text-to-speech output

properties.name: speechSpeed
properties.description: The speed of the generated audio, from 0.25 to 4.0 where 1.0 is normal speed

properties.name: speechVoice
properties.description: The voice to use for text-to-speech (e.g., alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer). See the OpenAI documentation for the full list of supported voices.

properties.name: storeFullResponse
properties.description: Store the full SDK response in non-streaming mode: chat-completion uses exchange property 'CamelOpenAIResponse'; responses uses 'CamelOpenAIResponsesResponse'; embeddings uses 'CamelOpenAIEmbeddingsResponse'; audio transcription uses 'CamelOpenAIAudioTranscriptionResponse'; audio translation uses 'CamelOpenAIAudioTranslationResponse'

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: Enable streaming responses

properties.name: stripThinking
properties.description: Strip ... blocks from model responses (used by reasoning models like Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1). The thinking content is stored in the CamelOpenAIThinkingContent header.

properties.name: systemMessage
properties.description: System message to prepend. When set and conversationMemory is enabled, the conversation history is reset.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Comma-separated tags for discovering route-based tools registered via the ai-tool component. When set, matching tools from the shared AiToolRegistry are exposed to the model alongside MCP tools.

properties.name: temperature
properties.description: Temperature for response generation (0.0 to 2.0)

properties.name: toolExecutionErrorStrategy
properties.description: Strategy for handling exceptions thrown during MCP tool execution. 'failExchange' (default) propagates the exception to the Camel exchange so that standard Camel error handling (onException, dead-letter channel) can process it. This is the safer default because 'repromptModel' sends raw exception messages (which may contain connection strings, hostnames, or internal paths) to a third-party LLM provider. 'repromptModel' catches the error and sends it back to the model as a tool result so the model can attempt to recover.

properties.name: topP
properties.description: Top P for response generation (0.0 to 1.0)

properties.name: userMessage
properties.description: Default user message text to use when no prompt is provided

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: oauthProfile
properties.label: security
properties.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token is acquired from the configured identity provider and used instead of apiKey. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath. The profile properties are resolved from camel.oauth..client-id, camel.oauth..client-secret, and camel.oauth..token-endpoint.

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: SSLContextParameters to use for configuring SSL/TLS. When set, takes precedence over the individual sslTruststore, sslKeystore, and sslProtocol options.

properties.name: sslEndpointAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: The endpoint identification algorithm to validate the server hostname using the server certificate. Set to an empty string or 'none' to disable hostname verification

properties.name: sslKeymanagerAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: The algorithm used by the key manager factory for SSL connections

properties.name: sslKeyPassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password of the private key in the key store file

properties.name: sslKeystoreLocation
properties.label: security
properties.description: The location of the key store file. This is optional and can be used for two-way authentication for the OpenAI API

properties.name: sslKeystorePassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The store password for the key store file

properties.name: sslKeystoreType
properties.label: security
properties.description: The file format of the key store file

properties.name: sslProtocol
properties.label: security
properties.description: The SSL protocol used to generate the SSLContext

properties.name: sslTrustmanagerAlgorithm
properties.label: security
properties.description: The algorithm used by the trust manager factory for SSL connections

properties.name: sslTruststoreLocation
properties.label: security
properties.description: The location of the trust store file, used to validate the server's certificate

properties.name: sslTruststorePassword
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password for the trust store file. If a password is not set, the configured trust store can still be used, but integrity checking is disabled

properties.name: sslTruststoreType
properties.label: security
properties.description: The file format of the trust store file
